title: Rubium
description: This mod add 3 ores and craft with theses ores
body:
This mod incorporates three new ores: rubium,fluorium and bluium, as well as the craft from these ores. The objects made with these minerals are stronger than diamond and give an effect

List of effects:

The Rubium helmet gives night vision
Rubium boots give speed
The sword of Rubium gives strength
This mod also adds two hammers: the Rubium hammer and the Bluium hammer

CurseForge - a world of endless gaming possibilities for modders and gamers alike.
